question: Why is my physical card (both EMV chip and magnetic stripe) disabled for overseas usage?

Do note that you will need to first activate your physical card if it's new, replaced or renewed. question: Can I use my Trust card overseas for point of sale transactions or ATM withdrawals?
answer: - For overseas transactions, if you are prompted by the overseas merchant to key in a PIN, inform the merchant to perform a signature or contactless based transaction instead. If the merchant insists on you keying in a PIN, then you can set or reset your Trust card PIN from the Trust App . For ATM withdrawals, do not use ATMs that accept 4 digit PINs as our cards only work at ATMs which use 6 digit PINs. Only use ATMs with the VISA – Plus Logo If you hold both a Trust Link credit card account and a savings account, we recommend that you pair your card with savings account and select ‘Savings Account’ at the ATM during cash withdrawals so that they are withdrawn from your savings account even if there is no option to select to withdraw from your savings account at the ATM. Do note that cash withdrawals under credit account option are cash advances and will incur a cash advance fee (effective from 1 Feb 26) and interest charges.

When withdrawing cash from an ATM, select the 'Savings Account' option to ensure that the funds are deducted from your savings account. question: When will I receive my earned Linkpoints (excluding monthly and quarterly bonus Linkpoints)?
answer: - We aim to credit the Linkpoints for your Eligible Spend to you in real-time (i.e., as soon as they are earned and posted!). However, there may be times when it can take us up to a day. Eligible Spend consists of Local Eligible Spend and Foreign Eligible Spend. Local Eligible Spend refers to all Visa transactions on your credit card or debit card in Singapore Dollars, and where the transaction is processed in Singapore, excluding FPG spend and ineligible transactions. You will receive 0.22% Linkpoints on all Local Eligible Spend, with no cap. For supplementary cardholders, Linkpoints will be awarded to the main cardholder. Foreign Eligible Spend refers to all Visa transactions made on your credit card or debit card that are not in Singapore Dollars, or where the transaction is processed outside of Singapore (including transactions that are converted into Singapore dollars via Dynamic Currency Conversion (DCC)), excluding FPG spend and ineligible transactions. You will receive 0.22% Linkpoints on all Foreign Eligible Spend, with no cap. For supplementary cardholders, Linkpoints will be awarded to the main cardholder. For the list of ineligible transactions, refer to https://trustbank.sg/faqs/linkpoints/#what-transactions-are-ineligible-transactions-and-will-therefore-not-earn-you-any-linkpoints?search=true

To clarify, eligible transactions include both local and foreign spend on your Horizon card. Local spend refers to Visa transactions in Singapore Dollars processed within Singapore, excluding certain spend categories. You can earn 0.22% rewards points on these local transactions without any cap. Similarly, foreign transactions, which include those in currencies other than Singapore Dollars or processed outside of Singapore, also earn 0.22% rewards points with no cap. For joint accounts, the main cardholder will receive the rewards points. For more details on transactions that do not qualify for rewards points, please visit our website at https://horizonbank.sg/faqs/linkpoints.

question: When will I receive my monthly bonus Linkpoints on FairPrice Group spend?

question: When will I receive my quarterly bonus Linkpoints on  FairPrice Group spend?
answer: - Once you've met your minimum monthly spend ($450 for NTUC Link Credit cardholders, $550 for Trust Link Credit cardholders, or $300 for NTUC Link Debit and Trust Link Debit cardholders) which is based on the posting date (not transaction date) of your transactions for 3 consecutive months starting from the first month that your card is approved, you'll receive the quarterly bonus Linkpoints on all your posted FPG spend* in the quarter. Earn additional quarterly bonus when you meet the following minimum monthly spend ($800 for NTUC Link Credit and Trust Link Credit cardholders, or $500 for NTUC Link Debit and Trust Link Debit cardholders) which is based on the posting date (not transaction date) of your transactions for 3 consecutive months starting from the first month that your card is approved, you'll receive the quarterly bonus Linkpoints on all your posted FPG spend* in the quarter. Subsequently, you'll receive the quarterly bonus Linkpoints on FPG spend* once they are posted in the month. *FPG groceries includes FairPrice, FairPrice Finest, FairPrice Xtra, FairPrice Xpress, FairPrice Online, Warehouse Club, Unity and Cheers stores (excluding FairPrice Xpress and Cheers outlets located within Esso stations) and FPG food includes participating Kopitiam stalls. FPG groceries and food spend will, together, also be referred to as FPG spend.
synth_question: How do I qualify for and receive the quarterly bonus Linkpoints on my FairPrice Group purchases made with my Horizon card?
synth_answer: To be eligible for the quarterly bonus Linkpoints on your FairPrice Group spend, you must first meet the minimum monthly spend requirement for three consecutive months, starting from the month your Horizon card is approved. The required spend amounts are $450 for NTUC Link Credit cardholders, $550 for Horizon Link Credit cardholders, or $300 for NTUC Link Debit and Horizon Link Debit cardholders, based on the posting date of your transactions.
